call_with_depth_limit(G, Limit, Result) :-
    '$depth_limit'(Limit, OLimit, OReached),
    (   catch(G, E, '$depth_limit_except'(OLimit, OReached, E)),
        '$depth_limit_true'(Limit, OLimit, OReached, Result, Det),

%!  call_with_inference_limit(:Goal, +InferenceLimit, -Result)
%
%   Equivalent to call(Goal),  but  poses  a   limit  on  the  number of
%   inferences. If this  limit  is  reached,   Result  is  unified  with
%   `inference_limit_exceeded`, otherwise Result is unified  with `!` if
%   Goal succeeded without a choicepoint and `true` otherwise.
%
%   Note that we perform calls in  system to avoid auto-importing, which
%   makes raiseInferenceLimitException() fail  to   recognise  that  the
%   exception happens in the overhead.

:- meta_predicate
    call_with_inference_limit(0, +, -).

call_with_inference_limit(G, Limit, Result) :-
    '$inference_limit'(Limit, OLimit),
    (   catch(G, Except,
              system:'$inference_limit_except'(OLimit, Except, Result0)),
        (   Result0 == inference_limit_exceeded
        ->  !
        ;   system:'$inference_limit_true'(Limit, OLimit, Result0),
            ( Result0 == ! -> ! ; true )
        ),
        Result = Result0
    ;   system:'$inference_limit_false'(OLimit)
    ).

%!  '$execute_query'(Goal, Bindings, -Truth) is det.
%
%   Execute Goal using Bindings.

'$execute_query'(Var, _, true) :-
    var(Var),
    !,
    print_message(informational, var_query(Var)).
'$execute_query'(Goal, Bindings, Truth) :-
    '$current_typein_module'(TypeIn),
    '$dwim_correct_goal'(TypeIn:Goal, Bindings, Corrected),
    !,
    setup_call_cleanup(
        '$set_source_module'(M0, TypeIn),
        expand_goal(Corrected, Expanded),
        '$set_source_module'(M0)),
    print_message(silent, toplevel_goal(Expanded, Bindings)),
    '$execute_goal2'(Expanded, Bindings, Truth).
'$execute_query'(_, _, false) :-
    notrace,
    no_answer,
    print_message(query, query(no)).

'$execute_goal2'(Goal, Bindings, true) :-
    restore_debug,
    '$current_typein_module'(TypeIn),
    residue_vars(TypeIn:Goal, Vars, TypeIn:Delays, Chp),
    deterministic(Det),
    (   save_debug
    ;   restore_debug, fail
    ),
    flush_output(user_output),
    (   Det == true
    ->  DetOrChp = true
    ;   DetOrChp = Chp
    ),
    call_expand_answer(Goal, Bindings, NewBindings),
    (    \+ \+ write_bindings(NewBindings, Vars, Delays, DetOrChp)
    ->   !
    ).
'$execute_goal2'(_, _, false) :-
    save_debug,
    no_answer,
    print_message(query, query(no)).

residue_vars(Goal, Vars, Delays, Chp) :-
    current_prolog_flag(toplevel_residue_vars, true),
    !,
    '$wfs_call'(call_residue_vars(stop_backtrace(Goal, Chp), Vars), Delays).
residue_vars(Goal, [], Delays, Chp) :-
    '$wfs_call'(stop_backtrace(Goal, Chp), Delays).

stop_backtrace(Goal, Chp) :-
    toplevel_call(Goal),
    prolog_current_choice(Chp).

toplevel_call(Goal) :-
    call(Goal),
    no_lco.

no_lco.

%!  write_bindings(+Bindings, +ResidueVars, +Delays, +DetOrChp)
%!	is semidet.
%
%   Write   bindings   resulting   from   a     query.    The   flag
%   prompt_alternatives_on determines whether the   user is prompted
%   for alternatives. =groundness= gives   the  classical behaviour,
%   =determinism= is considered more adequate and informative.
%
%   Succeeds if the user accepts the answer and fails otherwise.
%
%   @arg ResidueVars are the residual constraints and provided if
%        the prolog flag `toplevel_residue_vars` is set to
%        `project`.

write_bindings(Bindings, ResidueVars, Delays, DetOrChp) :-
    '$current_typein_module'(TypeIn),
    translate_bindings(Bindings, Bindings1, ResidueVars, TypeIn:Residuals),
    omit_qualifier(Delays, TypeIn, Delays1),
    next_answer(Bindings1, Delays1, Residuals),
    write_bindings2(Bindings, Bindings1, Residuals, Delays1, DetOrChp).

write_bindings2(OrgBindings, [], Residuals, Delays, _) :-
    current_prolog_flag(prompt_alternatives_on, groundness),
    !,
    name_vars(OrgBindings, [], t(Residuals, Delays)),
    print_message(query, query(yes(Delays, Residuals))).
write_bindings2(OrgBindings, Bindings, Residuals, Delays, true) :-
    current_prolog_flag(prompt_alternatives_on, determinism),
    !,
    name_vars(OrgBindings, Bindings, t(Residuals, Delays)),
    print_message(query, query(yes(Bindings, Delays, Residuals))).
write_bindings2(OrgBindings, Bindings, Residuals, Delays, Chp) :-
    repeat,
        name_vars(OrgBindings, Bindings, t(Residuals, Delays)),
        print_message(query, query(more(Bindings, Delays, Residuals))),
        get_respons(Action, Chp),
    (   Action == redo
    ->  !, fail
    ;   Action == show_again
    ->  fail
    ;   !,
        no_answer,
        print_message(query, query(done))
    ).

%!  name_vars(+OrgBinding, +Bindings, +Term) is det.
%
%   Give a name ``_[A-Z][0-9]*`` to all variables   in Term, that do not
%   have a name due to Bindings. Singleton   variables in Term are named
    collect_residual_goals(T).



%!  prolog:translate_bindings(+Bindings0, -Bindings, +ResidueVars,
%!                            +ResidualGoals, -Residuals) is det.
%
%   Translate the raw variable bindings  resulting from successfully
%   completing a query into a  binding   list  and  list of residual
%   goals suitable for human consumption.
%
%   @arg    Bindings is a list of binding(Vars,Value,Substitutions),
%           where Vars is a list of variable names. E.g.
%           binding(['A','B'],42,[])` means that both the variable
%           A and B have the value 42. Values may contain terms
%           '$VAR'(Name) to indicate sharing with a given variable.
%           Value is always an acyclic term. If cycles appear in the
%           answer, Substitutions contains a list of substitutions
%           that restore the original term.
%
%   @arg    Residuals is a pair of two lists representing residual
%           goals. The first element of the pair are residuals
%           related to the query variables and the second are
%           related that are disconnected from the query.

:- public
    prolog:translate_bindings/5.
:- meta_predicate
    prolog:translate_bindings(+, -, +, +, :).

prolog:translate_bindings(Bindings0, Bindings, ResVars, ResGoals, Residuals) :-
    translate_bindings(Bindings0, Bindings, ResVars, ResGoals, Residuals),
    name_vars(Bindings0, Bindings, t(ResVars, ResGoals, Residuals)).

% should not be required.
prolog:name_vars(Bindings, Term) :- name_vars([], Bindings, Term).
prolog:name_vars(Bindings0, Bindings, Term) :- name_vars(Bindings0, Bindings, Term).

translate_bindings(Bindings0, Bindings, ResidueVars, Residuals) :-
    prolog:residual_goals(ResidueGoals, []),
    translate_bindings(Bindings0, Bindings, ResidueVars, ResidueGoals,
                       Residuals).

translate_bindings(Bindings0, Bindings, [], [], _:[]-[]) :-
    term_attvars(Bindings0, []),
    !,
    join_same_bindings(Bindings0, Bindings1),
    factorize_bindings(Bindings1, Bindings2),
    bind_vars(Bindings2, Bindings3),
    filter_bindings(Bindings3, Bindings).
translate_bindings(Bindings0, Bindings, ResidueVars, ResGoals0,
                   TypeIn:Residuals-HiddenResiduals) :-
    project_constraints(Bindings0, ResidueVars),
    hidden_residuals(ResidueVars, Bindings0, HiddenResiduals0),
    omit_qualifiers(HiddenResiduals0, TypeIn, HiddenResiduals),
    copy_term(Bindings0+ResGoals0, Bindings1+ResGoals1, Residuals0),
    '$append'(ResGoals1, Residuals0, Residuals1),
    omit_qualifiers(Residuals1, TypeIn, Residuals),
    join_same_bindings(Bindings1, Bindings2),
    factorize_bindings(Bindings2, Bindings3),
    bind_vars(Bindings3, Bindings4),
    filter_bindings(Bindings4, Bindings).

hidden_residuals(ResidueVars, Bindings, Goal) :-
    term_attvars(ResidueVars, Remaining),
    term_attvars(Bindings, QueryVars),
    subtract_vars(Remaining, QueryVars, HiddenVars),
    copy_term(HiddenVars, _, Goal).

subtract_vars(All, Subtract, Remaining) :-
    sort(All, AllSorted),

/*  SWI-Prolog harness, the Prolog side (cp-roles, spec-1.0, wave 1).

    Loaded by harnesses/swi-prolog/run, before the program, in a fresh
    `swipl` process. The Python driver (run) writes a control file of
    ctl(Key, Value) facts and starts

        swipl -f none --no-tty -q -g cp_harness:h_main(CtlFile) -t halt harness.pl

    This file never holds or computes anything a program is asked for. It
    passes stages in (by calling the program's stage/2, query/2 and
    spawned/3 in order), collects answers by backtracking (the system's
    standard mechanism), renders them with the toplevel's own code, reads
    state for observe(), enforces the budget, and reports events to the
    driver as JSON lines. Everything it does beyond that is listed in
    harnesses/swi-prolog/README.md, "Confounds".

    Steps. Every inference spent inside harness code that runs inside the
    measured computation (stage marks, answer points, the H predicates a
    program calls, the storage sampler) is excluded from the step count and
    from the budget: each such piece of code runs "paused" (h_paused/3),
    which reads the inference counter on entry and on exit, adds what it
    used to an exclusion counter, and moves the inference limit on by the
    same amount. The qualification checks that the steps reported equal
    the systems file's measurement (statistics(inferences) difference,
    minus one) of the program's own goals.
*/

:- module(cp_harness,
          [ h_param/2,            % +Name, -Value
            h_commitment/1,       % -Verbatim
            emit/1,               % +Message   (P11's effects stub)
            h_count/1,            % +Name      (problem operations)
            h_candidate/0,        %            (P12 candidates examined)
            h_held/2,             % +Name, +Count (problem-defined alternatives)
            h_wait/0              %            (session: wait for the next stage)
          ]).

:- use_module(library(lists), [member/2, append/3, nth1/3, sum_list/2]).
:- use_module(library(apply), [maplist/3, maplist/2, foldl/4]).
:- use_module(library(prolog_autoload), [autoload_all/0]).

:- dynamic ctl/2.
:- dynamic cnt/2.                % problem-operation counters, by computation
:- dynamic held/3.               % problem-defined alternatives, by computation

huge(1152921504606846976).       % 2^60: "no limit" when read back

                 /*******************************
                 *          ENTRY POINT         *
                 *******************************/

h_main(CtlFile) :-
    catch(h_main_(CtlFile), E, h_fatal(E)),
    h_halt(0).

h_fatal(E) :-
    (   catch(message_text(E, T), _, fail) -> true ; format(string(T), "~q", [E]) ),
    catch(ev(harness_fault, [text-T]), _, true),
    h_halt(3).

h_halt(S) :-
    catch(flush_output(user_output), _, true),
    catch(flush_output(user_error), _, true),
    halt(S).

h_main_(CtlFile) :-
    read_ctl(CtlFile),
    ctl(events, EvFile),
    open(EvFile, append, EvS, [encoding(utf8), buffer(line)]),
    nb_setval(h_events, EvS),
    (   ctl(spool, Spool), Spool \== none
    ->  open(Spool, append, SpS, [encoding(utf8), buffer(line)]),
        nb_setval(h_spool, SpS)
    ;   nb_setval(h_spool, none)
    ),
    current_prolog_flag(version, V),
    current_prolog_flag(optimise, O),
    current_prolog_flag(occurs_check, OC0),
    current_prolog_flag(unknown, U0),
    ev(start, [version-V, optimise-O, occurs_check_default-OC0, unknown_default-U0]),
    set_prolog_flag(answer_write_options,
                    [quoted(true), portray(true), max_depth(0), spacing(next_argument)]),
    set_prolog_flag(toplevel_print_anon, true),
    install_hooks,
    ctl(program, Prog),
    load_program(Prog),
    run_plan,
    ev(done, []),
    close(EvS).

read_ctl(File) :-
    setup_call_cleanup(open(File, read, S, [encoding(utf8)]),
                       read_ctl_terms(S),
                       close(S)).
read_ctl_terms(S) :-
    read_term(S, T, []),
    (   T == end_of_file
    ->  true
    ;   assertz(T),
        read_ctl_terms(S)
    ).

%   The program is loaded into user, then every predicate its clauses can
%   reach is autoloaded, so that no library is loaded while a stage is
%   measured (systems file, "Units": autoloading adds inferences, and a
%   limit reached during autoloading leaves a library undefined).

load_program(Prog) :-
    catch(load_files(user:Prog, [if(true)]), E, true),
    flush_output(user_output), flush_output(user_error),
    (   var(E)
    ->  catch(autoload_all, E2, true),
        (   var(E2) -> true
        ;   message_text(E2, T2), ev(note, [text-T2])
        ),
        current_prolog_flag(occurs_check, OC),
        current_prolog_flag(unknown, Unk),
        ev(loaded, [occurs_check-OC, unknown-Unk])
    ;   message_text(E, T),
        ev(load_error, [text-T]),
        h_halt(0)
    ).

                 /*******************************
                 *             EVENTS           *
                 *******************************/

%   ev(+Kind, +Pairs): one JSON object per line on the events stream.

ev(Kind, Pairs) :-
    nb_getval(h_events, S),
    get_time(T),
    json_out(S, [ev-Kind, t-T|Pairs]),
    nl(S),
    flush_output(S).

json_out(S, Pairs) :-
    is_list(Pairs), Pairs = [_-_|_], !,
    put_char(S, '{'),
    json_pairs(Pairs, S),
    put_char(S, '}').
json_out(S, obj([])) :- !, write(S, '{}').
json_out(S, obj(Pairs)) :- !, json_out(S, Pairs).
json_out(S, list(L)) :- !,
    put_char(S, '['), json_items(L, S), put_char(S, ']').
json_out(S, null) :- !, write(S, null).
json_out(S, true) :- !, write(S, true).
json_out(S, false) :- !, write(S, false).
json_out(S, N) :- integer(N), !, write(S, N).
json_out(S, N) :- float(N), !, format(S, "~15g", [N]).
json_out(S, X) :- json_string(S, X).

json_pairs([], _).
json_pairs([K-V|T], S) :-
    json_string(S, K), put_char(S, ':'), json_out(S, V),
    (   T == [] -> true ; put_char(S, ','), json_pairs(T, S) ).
json_items([], _).
json_items([H|T], S) :-
    json_out(S, H),
    (   T == [] -> true ; put_char(S, ','), json_items(T, S) ).

json_string(S, X) :-
    (   string(X) -> Str = X
    ;   atom(X) -> atom_string(X, Str)
    ;   format(string(Str), "~q", [X])
    ),
    string_codes(Str, Cs),
    put_char(S, '"'),
    maplist(json_char(S), Cs),
    put_char(S, '"').
json_char(S, 0'") :- !, write(S, '\\"').
json_char(S, 0'\\) :- !, write(S, '\\\\').
json_char(S, 0'\n) :- !, write(S, '\\n').
json_char(S, 0'\r) :- !, write(S, '\\r').
json_char(S, 0'\t) :- !, write(S, '\\t').
json_char(S, C) :- C < 0x20, !, format(S, "\\u~|~`0t~16r~4+", [C]).
json_char(S, C) :- put_code(S, C).

                 /*******************************
                 *       STEPS AND BUDGET       *
                 *******************************/

%   Per computation (main thread, or inside an engine, whose global
%   variables are its own):
%     h_base   raw inference count when the computation started
%     h_excl   (flag h_excl_<id>) inferences spent in paused harness code
%   Program steps now = raw - h_base - h_excl - (the paused code's entry).

comp_flag(Comp, Key, Flag) :- atomic_list_concat([Key, '_', Comp], Flag).

%   h_paused(+Pre, :Goal, +Kind)
%   Run Goal (a harness goal) without counting its inferences in the
%   program's steps or against the budget. Pre is the number of
%   inferences spent before the first statistics/2 call (the call ports of
%   the H predicate and of h_paused/3, and anything the caller did first).
%   Goal is called as call(Goal, StepsNow, Limit0, Limit) where StepsNow
%   is the program's step count at entry, Limit0 the absolute raw
%   inference limit at entry, and Limit the limit to restore (before the
%   pause's own cost is added).

h_paused(Pre, G, _) :-
    statistics(inferences, A),
    huge(H),
    '$inference_limit'(H, L0),
    (   '$inference_limit_false'(infinite) -> true ; true ),
    nb_getval(h_comp, Comp),
    comp_flag(Comp, h_excl, XF),
    flag(XF, X0, X0),
    nb_getval(h_base, Base),
    Steps is A - Pre - Base - X0,
    (   catch(call(G, Steps, L0, L1), E, (h_paused_fault(E), L1 = L0))
    ->  true
    ;   L1 = L0
    ),
    statistics(inferences, Z),
    Cost is Z - A + Pre + 3,
    flag(XF, X1, X1+Cost),
    L2 is L1 + Cost,
    (   '$inference_limit_false'(L2) -> true ; true ).

h_paused_fault(E) :-
    catch(( message_text(E, T), ev(harness_fault, [text-T]) ), _, true).

%   Program steps at a point outside paused code (after a failure or an
%   exception, in the main thread). Pre: inferences since the program last
%   ran, up to and including this statistics/2 call.
steps_now(Pre, Steps) :-
    statistics(inferences, A),
    nb_getval(h_comp, Comp),
    comp_flag(Comp, h_excl, XF),
    flag(XF, X0, X0),
    nb_getval(h_base, Base),
    Steps is A - Pre - Base - X0.

set_limit(L) :- ( '$inference_limit_false'(L) -> true ; true ).

                 /*******************************
                 *      HOOKS: BUDGET, SAMPLER  *
                 *******************************/

:- multifile prolog:prolog_exception_hook/5.
:- dynamic prolog:prolog_exception_hook/5.

install_hooks :-
    asserta(( prolog:prolog_exception_hook(E, E, _Fr, Catcher, _Dbg) :-
                  cp_harness:exception_seen(E, Catcher), fail )),
    (   ctl(mode, storage)
    ->  asserta(( prolog:heartbeat :- cp_harness:h_sample ))
    ;   true
    ).
:- multifile prolog:heartbeat/0.
:- dynamic prolog:heartbeat/0.

%   At the moment the budget runs out (or the program raises an error that
%   reaches the harness), before the stacks are unwound, read the state:
%   the bindings held, residual goals, and (storage mode) the retained
%   choicepoints and the store. The exception itself is not changed.
exception_seen(E, Catcher) :-
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    nb_current(h_armed, true),
    \+ nb_current(h_exc_seen, true),
    catcher_is_harness(Catcher),
    nb_setval(h_exc_seen, true),
    (   E == inference_limit_exceeded -> Why = budget ; Why = error ),
    statistics(inferences, A),
    nb_getval(h_comp, Comp),
    comp_flag(Comp, h_excl, XF), flag(XF, X0, X0),
    nb_getval(h_base, Base),
    Steps is A - Base - X0,
    b_getval(h_vars, VB),
    (   b_getval(h_part, Part) -> true ; Part = 0 ),
    nb_getval(h_mark, Mark),
    state_pairs(VB, Mark, Ch, 'at-exception', Obs),
    ev(at_exception, [comp-Comp, why-Why, steps-Steps, part-Part|Obs]).

catcher_is_harness(none) :- !.
catcher_is_harness(Catcher) :-
    nb_getval(h_catch_frame, F),
    (   Catcher == F -> true
    ;   prolog_frame_attribute(Catcher, parent, P), P == F
    ).

%   Storage mode only: a sampled maximum of retained choicepoints, stack
%   usage and table space, every N inferences (heartbeat flag), with
%   running maxima kept off the stacks in flag/3 (systems file, "Store").
h_sample :-
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    nb_current(h_armed, true),
    h_paused(2, sample_(Ch), sample).
sample_(Ch, _Steps, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_comp, Comp),
    nb_getval(h_mark, Mark),
    cp_count(Ch, Mark, N, _),
    upd(Comp, cp, N),
    statistics(globalused, G), upd(Comp, globalused, G),
    statistics(localused, Lo), upd(Comp, localused, Lo),
    statistics(trailused, T), upd(Comp, trailused, T),
    (   ctl(config, tabling) -> statistics(table_space_used, TS), upd(Comp, table_space_used, TS) ; true ),
    comp_flag(Comp, smp_n, NF), flag(NF, K, K+1).
upd(Comp, Key, V) :-
    atomic_list_concat([smp, Key, Comp], '_', F),
    flag(F, Old, max(Old, V)).
sampled(Comp, Key, V) :-
    atomic_list_concat([smp, Key, Comp], '_', F),
    flag(F, V, V).
reset_samples(Comp) :-
    forall(member(K, [cp, globalused, localused, trailused, table_space_used]),
           ( atomic_list_concat([smp, K, Comp], '_', F), flag(F, _, 0) )),
    comp_flag(Comp, smp_n, NF), flag(NF, _, 0).

                 /*******************************
                 *          CHOICEPOINTS        *
                 *******************************/

%   Retained choicepoints: frames newer than the mark taken when the
%   computation started, by type (systems file, "Alternative").
cp_count(C, M, N, Types) :- cp_walk(C, M, 0, N, [], Types).
cp_walk(C, M, N0, N, T0, T) :-
    (   C =< M
    ->  N = N0, T = T0
    ;   N1 is N0+1,
        (   prolog_choice_attribute(C, type, Ty) -> true ; Ty = unknown ),
        cp_add(Ty, T0, T1),
        (   prolog_choice_attribute(C, parent, P)
        ->  cp_walk(P, M, N1, N, T1, T)
        ;   N = N1, T = T1
        )
    ).
cp_add(Ty, [], [Ty-1]) :- !.
cp_add(Ty, [Ty-K|R], [Ty-K1|R]) :- !, K1 is K+1.
cp_add(Ty, [X|R], [X|R1]) :- cp_add(Ty, R, R1).

                 /*******************************
                 *       RENDERING (TOPLEVEL)   *
                 *******************************/

%   The toplevel's own rendering of an answer: translate_bindings/4,
%   name_vars/3 and the query(yes/more) message, as write_bindings/4 in
%   boot/toplevel.pl does it, with answer_write_options max_depth(0) so
%   that nothing is elided. Done under \+ \+, so no binding survives.

render_answer(VB, Det, Text, Bindings) :-
    \+ \+ ( render_(VB, Det, T, B), nb_setval(h_render, T-B) ),
    nb_getval(h_render, Text-Bindings).

render_(VB, Det, Text, Bindings) :-
    '$toplevel':translate_bindings(VB, B1, [], user:Res),
    '$toplevel':name_vars(VB, B1, t(Res, true)),
    (   Det == true
    ->  Msg = query(yes(B1, true, Res))
    ;   Msg = query(more(B1, true, Res))
    ),
    message_string(Msg, Text),
    binding_texts(B1, Bindings).

binding_texts(B1, Pairs) :-
    current_prolog_flag(answer_write_options, Opts),
    findall(Name-VT,
            ( member(binding(Names, Value, _Subst), B1),
              member(Name, Names),
              format(string(VT), "~W", [Value, Opts])
            ),
            Pairs).

message_string(Msg, Text) :-
    phrase('$messages':translate_message(Msg), Lines),
    with_output_to(string(Text), print_message_lines(current_output, '', Lines)).

message_text(E, Text) :-
    (   catch(phrase('$messages':translate_message(E), Lines), _, fail)
    ->  with_output_to(string(Text), print_message_lines(current_output, kind(error), Lines))
    ;   format(string(Text), "~q", [E])
    ).

%   State at a point: rendering of the bindings held, attributed variables
%   reachable from the unknowns, residual goals, and in storage mode the
%   retained choicepoints and the store vector.
state_pairs(VB, Mark, Ch, Where, Pairs) :-
    Det = false,
    render_answer(VB, Det, Text, Bs),
    pairs_obj(Bs, BObj),
    term_attvars(VB, AVs), length(AVs, NAV),
    \+ \+ ( copy_term(VB, _, Gs), length(Gs, NG), nb_setval(h_ng, NG) ),
    nb_getval(h_ng, NG),
    (   ctl(mode, storage)
    ->  cp_count(Ch, Mark, NCP, Types), pairs_obj(Types, TObj),
        store_pairs(SObj),
        Extra = [cps-NCP, cp_types-TObj, store-SObj]
    ;   Extra = [cps-null, cp_types-null, store-obj([])]
    ),
    Pairs = [where-Where, text-Text, bindings-BObj, attvars-NAV, residual_goals-NG|Extra].

pairs_obj(Ps, obj(Ps)).

store_pairs(obj(Ps)) :-
    garbage_collect,
    statistics(globalused, G), statistics(localused, L), statistics(trailused, T),
    (   ctl(config, tabling)
    ->  statistics(table_space_used, TS),
        aggregate_tables(NT, NA),
        Ps = [global_live_bytes-G, local_bytes-L, trail_bytes-T,
              table_space_used_bytes-TS, tables-NT, table_answers-NA]
    ;   Ps = [global_live_bytes-G, local_bytes-L, trail_bytes-T]
    ).

aggregate_tables(NT, NA) :-
    findall(C, ( current_table(_:_, Tr), trie_property(Tr, value_count(C)) ), Cs),
    length(Cs, NT), sum_list(Cs, NA).

                 /*******************************
                 *        H PREDICATES          *
                 *******************************/

%!  h_param(+Name, -Value)
%   The instance's parameters (n, order, answers, cap, spawn_order), as
%   stages.json gives them.
h_param(Name, Value) :-
    h_paused(2, param_(Name, V), param),
    Value = V.
param_(Name, V, _, L, L) :- ctl(params, Ps), memberchk(Name-V, Ps).

%!  h_commitment(-Verbatim)
%   Succeeds, with the answer the commit stage reported, verbatim, when the
%   stage being posed is a commit stage replayed with a selected value.
h_commitment(V) :-
    h_paused(2, commitment_(V0), commitment),
    V0 \== none,
    V = V0.
commitment_(V, _, L, L) :-
    (   b_getval(h_part, J), ctl(commitments, Cs), memberchk(J-V, Cs) -> true ; V = none ).

%!  emit(+M)
%   P11's effects stub: appends one entry to the log, and returns.
emit(M) :-
    h_paused(2, emit_(M), emit).
emit_(M, _, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_spool, S),
    (   S == none
    ->  ev(harness_fault, [text-"emit/1 called, but this problem has no effects log"])
    ;   current_prolog_flag(answer_write_options, Opts),
        format(string(Text), "~W", [M, Opts]),
        nb_getval(h_k, K),
        (   b_getval(h_part, J) -> true ; J = K ),
        ctl(posing_now, How),
        (   How == reposed, J < K -> R = J ; R = null ),
        ctl(attempt, Att),
        ctl(log_kind, LK),
        json_out(S, [entry-Text, stage-K, attempt-Att, during_replay_of-R, log-LK]),
        nl(S), flush_output(S)
    ).

%!  h_count(+Name)
%   One application of a case of a relation the problem defines.
h_count(Name) :-
    h_paused(2, count_(Name), count).
count_(Name, _, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_comp, C),
    (   retract(cnt(C, Name-N0)) -> N is N0+1 ; N = 1 ),
    assertz(cnt(C, Name-N)).

%!  h_candidate
%   P12: one sequence s for which accept(s) is evaluated.
h_candidate :-
    h_paused(2, count_('$candidates_examined'), count).

%!  h_held(+Name, +Count)
%   Problem-defined alternatives held now (the last value at the stage
%   boundary is recorded).
h_held(Name, Count) :-
    h_paused(2, held_(Name, Count), held).
held_(Name, Count, _, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_comp, C),
    retractall(held(C, Name, _)),
    assertz(held(C, Name, Count)).

%!  h_wait
%   session only: the computation waits here for the next stage. The
%   harness records the stage as ended with the computation waiting, and
%   when it poses the next stage, h_wait/0 receives it into this
%   computation (marks it, calls stage/2 for it) and returns.
h_wait :-
    (   nb_current(h_engine, true)
    ->  h_paused(2, wait_yield(Msg), wait),
        pose_msg(Msg)
    ;   throw(error(permission_error(call, h_wait, 'outside session'), _))
    ).
wait_yield(Msg, Steps, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_k, K),
    b_getval(h_vars, VB),
    nb_getval(h_mark, Mark),
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    state_pairs(VB, Mark, Ch, waiting, Obs),
    point_extra(Extra),
    engine_yield('$h_waiting'(K, Steps, [where-waiting|Obs], Extra)),
    engine_fetch(Msg).

                 /*******************************
                 *        STAGE MARKS           *
                 *******************************/

%   h_m(+J): placed before stage(J, Vars) in the posed conjunction. On the
%   first entry it records the step count (the restart cost, when J is the
%   stage being posed in a reposed run), and gives stage J its budget from
%   here; on every entry it sets h_part (backtrackable) for emit/1.

h_m(J) :-
    h_paused(2, m_(J), mark).
m_(J, Steps, L0, L) :-
    b_setval(h_part, J),
    nb_getval(h_comp, Comp),
    comp_flag(Comp, h_entered, EF),
    flag(EF, E0, E0),
    (   J > E0
    ->  flag(EF, _, J),
        ctl(budget, B),
        statistics(inferences, Now),
        L is Now + B,                    % paused cost is added on exit
        ev(enter, [comp-Comp, stage-J, steps-Steps]),
        (   nb_current(h_engine, true) -> nb_setval(h_k, J) ; true )
    ;   L = L0
    ).

                 /*******************************
                 *             PLANS            *
                 *******************************/

%   ctl(plan, reposed(K, Comps))   plain, tabling, coroutines, constraints:
%       stages 1..K posed together (replay 1..K-1), answers collected here.
%   ctl(plan, session(Stages))     session: an engine; each element
%       post(J, Collect) posts stage J (Collect = replay, point, here).
%   Comps: list of comp(Id, Kind, Cap) with Kind main or spawned(J).

run_plan :-
    ctl(plan, Plan),
    run_plan(Plan).

run_plan(reposed(K, Comps)) :-
    maplist(run_comp(K), Comps).
run_plan(session(Posts, Comps)) :-
    session_main(Posts),
    maplist(run_comp_spawned_only, Comps).

run_comp_spawned_only(comp(Id, spawned(J), Cap)) :- !, run_comp(J, comp(Id, spawned(J), Cap)).
run_comp_spawned_only(_).

%   One computation in the main thread: build the conjunction, take the
%   mark, run it under the budget, collect answers by backtracking.

run_comp(K, comp(Comp, Kind, Cap)) :-
    unknown_vars(Comp, VB, Vars),
    build_goal(Kind, K, Vars, Goal),
    start_comp(Comp, K),
    b_setval(h_vars, VB),
    nb_setval(h_cap, Cap),
    nb_setval(h_count, 0),
    collect(Comp, Goal, VB, Cap),
    true.

unknown_vars(Comp, VB, Vars) :-
    (   catch(user:unknowns(Comp, Names), _, fail), is_list(Names)
    ->  true
    ;   Names = []
    ),
    length(Names, N), length(Vars, N),
    maplist([Nm, V, Nm=V]>>true, Names, Vars, VB).

build_goal(main, K, Vars, Goal) :-
    numlist(1, K, Js),
    foldl(conj_stage(Vars), Js, true, G0),
    conj(G0, user:query(K, Vars), Goal).
build_goal(spawned(J), _, Vars, (cp_harness:h_m(J), user:spawned(J, Comp, Vars))) :-
    nb_getval(h_comp, Comp).
conj_stage(Vars, J, G0, G) :-
    conj(G0, (cp_harness:h_m(J), user:stage(J, Vars)), G).
conj(true, G, G) :- !.
conj(A, B, (A, B)).

start_comp(Comp, K) :-
    nb_setval(h_comp, Comp),
    nb_setval(h_k, K),
    comp_flag(Comp, h_excl, XF), flag(XF, _, 0),
    comp_flag(Comp, h_entered, EF), flag(EF, _, 0),
    retractall(cnt(Comp, _)),
    retractall(held(Comp, _, _)),
    reset_samples(Comp),
    nb_setval(h_exc_seen, false),
    flush_output(user_output), flush_output(user_error),
    out_positions(OB, EB),
    ev(comp_start, [comp-Comp, stage-K, out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB]),
    (   ctl(mode, storage)
    ->  garbage_collect,
        statistics(globalused, G0), statistics(localused, L0), statistics(trailused, T0),
        ev(store_start, [comp-Comp, store-obj([global_live_bytes-G0, local_bytes-L0, trail_bytes-T0])])
    ;   true
    ).

out_positions(OB, EB) :-
    ( catch(byte_count(user_output, OB), _, fail) -> true ; OB = null ),
    ( catch(byte_count(user_error, EB), _, fail) -> true ; EB = null ).

%   The goal is compiled into one clause, so that the posed conjunction is
%   what a toplevel query would run: no harness glue between the stages
%   except the marks, whose inferences are excluded.
collect(Comp, Goal, VB, Cap) :-
    retractall(user:'$cp_query'(_)),
    assertz((user:'$cp_query'(VB) :- Goal)),
    statistics(inferences, I0),
    nb_setval(h_base, I0),
    nb_setval(h_armed, true),
    (   ctl(mode, storage)
    ->  current_prolog_flag(heartbeat, HB0), nb_setval(h_hb0, HB0),
        ctl(heartbeat, HB), set_prolog_flag(heartbeat, HB)
    ;   true
    ),
    catch_frame(Comp, VB, Cap, Result),
    nb_setval(h_armed, false),
    (   ctl(mode, storage) -> nb_getval(h_hb0, HBr), set_prolog_flag(heartbeat, HBr) ; true ),
    set_limit(infinite),
    finish(Comp, VB, Result).

catch_frame(Comp, VB, Cap, Result) :-
    prolog_current_frame(F),
    nb_setval(h_catch_frame, F),
    catch(query_answers(Comp, VB, Cap, R0), E, R0 = exception(E)),
    !,
    Result = R0.

query_answers(_Comp, VB, _Cap, Result) :-
    prolog_current_choice(M),
    nb_setval(h_mark, M),
    (   user:'$cp_query'(VB),
        h_answer(VB, Stop),
        Stop == true
    ->  nb_getval(h_stop_how, Result)
    ;   steps_now(4, S), Result = exhausted(S)
    ).

%   h_answer(+VB, -Stop): the answer point. Render the answer, report it,
%   and stop (Stop = true) when the cap is reached or the goal exited
%   without choicepoints; otherwise fail into the goal for the next answer.
h_answer(VB, Stop) :-
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    h_paused(3, answer_(VB, Ch, Stop0), answer),
    Stop = Stop0.

answer_(VB, Ch, Stop, Steps, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_mark, M),
    (   Ch =< M -> Det = true ; Det = false ),
    nb_getval(h_count, I0), I is I0+1, nb_setval(h_count, I),
    nb_getval(h_cap, Cap),
    render_answer(VB, Det, Text, Bs), pairs_obj(Bs, BObj),
    (   ctl(mode, storage) -> cp_count(Ch, M, NCP, _) ; NCP = null ),
    nb_getval(h_comp, Comp),
    ev(answer, [comp-Comp, index-I, text-Text, bindings-BObj, steps-Steps, det-Det, cps-NCP]),
    (   Det == true
    ->  Stop = true, End = det
    ;   I >= Cap
    ->  Stop = true, End = cap
    ;   Stop = false, End = none
    ),
    (   Stop == true
    ->  state_pairs(VB, M, Ch, boundary, Obs),
        point_extra(Extra),
        nb_setval(h_stop_how, stopped(End, Steps, Det, Obs, Extra))
    ;   true
    ).

point_extra([counts-CObj, held-HObj, samples-SObj]) :-
    nb_getval(h_comp, C),
    findall(N-V, cnt(C, N-V), Cs), CObj = obj(Cs),
    findall(N-V, held(C, N, V), Hs), HObj = obj(Hs),
    (   ctl(mode, storage)
    ->  findall(K-V, ( member(K, [cp, globalused, localused, trailused, table_space_used]),
                       sampled(C, K, V) ), Ss0),
        comp_flag(C, smp_n, NF), flag(NF, NS, NS),
        ctl(heartbeat, HB),
        SObj = obj([n-NS, interval-HB|Ss0])
    ;   SObj = null
    ).

finish(Comp, VB, Result) :-
    flush_output(user_output), flush_output(user_error),
    out_positions(OB, EB),
    (   Result = stopped(End, Steps, Det, Obs, Extra)
    ->  Pairs = [ended_by-End, steps-Steps, det-Det, observe-obj(Obs)|Extra]
    ;   Result = exhausted(Steps)
    ->  point_extra(Extra),
        (   ctl(mode, storage) -> store_pairs(Store) ; Store = obj([]) ),
        Pairs = [ended_by-exhausted, steps-Steps, det-false,
                 observe-obj([where-'after-failure', store-Store])|Extra]
    ;   Result = exception(E)
    ->  steps_now(0, Steps0),
        point_extra(Extra),
        (   E == inference_limit_exceeded
        ->  End = budget, Text = null
        ;   End = error, message_text(E, Text)
        ),
        format(string(Term), "~q", [E]),
        Pairs = [ended_by-End, steps-Steps0, error_text-Text, error_term-Term|Extra]
    ),
    ev(comp_end, [comp-Comp, out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Pairs]),
    ignore(VB = VB).

                 /*******************************
                 *            SESSION           *
                 *******************************/

%   The main computation is an engine, created once; each stage is posted
%   into it (engine_post/3). The engine runs engine_loop/0: it fetches a
%   message stage(J, Collect), marks and calls stage(J, Vars), and then
%   at the stage's point yields the rendering of what it holds. Collect:
%     replay  a stage replayed in a reposed or separate run: yield at once
%     point   yield the state held (print, observe), not consuming it
%     here    call query(J, Vars) and collect answers by backtracking
%             inside the engine (only where nothing extends the
%             computation afterwards: the instance's last stage, or the
%             last stage of a separate run)

session_main(Posts) :-
    unknown_vars(main, VB, Vars),
    nb_setval(h_comp, main),
    ctl(budget, B),
    engine_create(R, engine_main(VB, Vars, B, R), E, [alias(cp_session)]),
    nb_setval(h_eng, E),
    session_posts(Posts, E).

engine_main(VB, Vars, _B, R) :-
    nb_setval(h_engine, true),
    nb_setval(h_comp, main),
    nb_setval(h_k, 0),
    comp_flag(main, h_excl, XF), flag(XF, _, 0),
    comp_flag(main, h_entered, EF), flag(EF, _, 0),
    b_setval(h_vars, VB),
    nb_setval(h_vars_list, Vars),
    nb_setval(h_exc_seen, false),
    statistics(inferences, I0),
    nb_setval(h_base, I0),
    nb_setval(h_armed, true),
    (   ctl(mode, storage) -> ctl(heartbeat, HB), set_prolog_flag(heartbeat, HB) ; true ),
    prolog_current_frame(F),
    nb_setval(h_catch_frame, F),
    catch(engine_body(VB, Vars, R), Ex, R = '$h_exception'(Ex)).

engine_body(VB, Vars, R) :-
    prolog_current_choice(M),
    nb_setval(h_mark, M),
    engine_fetch(Msg),
    engine_loop(Msg, VB, Vars, R).

engine_loop(Msg, VB, Vars, R) :-
    pose_msg(Msg),
    nb_getval(h_collect, Collect),
    (   Collect == here
    ->  nb_getval(h_k, K),
        user:query(K, Vars),
        h_eanswer(VB, Stop),
        Stop == true,
        R = '$h_stopped'
    ;   h_epoint(VB, Next),
        engine_loop(Next, VB, Vars, R)
    ).

%   Receive a stage message into the computation.
pose_msg(stage(J, Collect)) :-
    nb_setval(h_collect, Collect),
    h_m(J),
    nb_getval(h_vars_list, Vars),
    user:stage(J, Vars).

h_epoint(VB, Next) :-
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    h_paused(3, epoint_(VB, Ch, Next0), point),
    Next = Next0.
epoint_(VB, Ch, Next, Steps, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_k, K),
    nb_getval(h_collect, Collect),
    nb_getval(h_mark, M),
    (   Collect == replay
    ->  Obs = [], Extra = []
    ;   state_pairs(VB, M, Ch, boundary, Obs),
        point_extra(Extra)
    ),
    (   Ch =< M -> Det = true ; Det = false ),
    engine_yield('$h_point'(K, Steps, Det, Obs, Extra)),
    engine_fetch(Next).

h_eanswer(VB, Stop) :-
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    h_paused(3, eanswer_(VB, Ch, Stop0), answer),
    Stop = Stop0.
eanswer_(VB, Ch, Stop, Steps, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_mark, M),
    (   Ch =< M -> Det = true ; Det = false ),
    render_answer(VB, Det, Text, Bs),
    (   ctl(mode, storage) -> cp_count(Ch, M, NCP, _) ; NCP = null ),
    state_pairs(VB, M, Ch, boundary, Obs),
    point_extra(Extra),
    engine_yield('$h_answer'(Text, Bs, Steps, Det, NCP, Obs, Extra)),
    engine_fetch(Msg),
    (   Msg == '$h_more' -> Stop = false ; Stop = true ).

%   The main thread's side: post each stage and report what the engine
%   gives back.
session_posts([], _).
session_posts([post(J, Collect)|Ps], E) :-
    flush_output(user_output), flush_output(user_error),
    out_positions(OB, EB),
    ev(post, [stage-J, collect-Collect, out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB]),
    (   catch(engine_post(E, stage(J, Collect), Reply), Ex, Reply = '$h_exception'(Ex))
    ->  true
    ;   Reply = '$h_failed'
    ),
    session_reply(Reply, J, Collect, E, Cont),
    (   Cont == true -> session_posts(Ps, E) ; true ).

session_reply('$h_point'(K, Steps, Det, Obs, Extra), J, Collect, _, true) :- !,
    session_out(OB, EB),
    ev(point, [stage-J, k-K, collect-Collect, steps-Steps, det-Det, observe-obj(Obs),
               out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra]).
session_reply('$h_waiting'(K, Steps, Obs, Extra), J, Collect, _, true) :- !,
    session_out(OB, EB),
    ev(waiting, [stage-J, k-K, collect-Collect, steps-Steps, observe-obj(Obs),
                 out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra]).
session_reply('$h_answer'(Text, Bs, Steps, Det, NCP, Obs, Extra), J, _, E, false) :- !,
    pairs_obj(Bs, BObj),
    ev(answer, [comp-main, stage-J, index-1, text-Text, bindings-BObj, steps-Steps, det-Det, cps-NCP]),
    nb_getval(h_cap_main, Cap),
    session_more(1, Cap, Det, Steps, Obs, Extra, J, E).
session_reply(Other, J, _, E, false) :-
    session_end(Other, J, E, null, []).

session_more(I, Cap, Det, Steps, Obs, Extra, J, E) :-
    (   Det == true
    ->  session_out(OB, EB),
        ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-det, steps-Steps, det-true, observe-obj(Obs),
                      out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra])
    ;   I >= Cap
    ->  session_out(OB, EB),
        ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-cap, steps-Steps, det-false, observe-obj(Obs),
                      out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra])
    ;   (   catch(engine_post(E, '$h_more', Reply), Ex, Reply = '$h_exception'(Ex))
        ->  true
        ;   Reply = '$h_failed'
        ),
        (   Reply = '$h_answer'(Text, Bs, Steps1, Det1, NCP1, Obs1, Extra1)
        ->  I1 is I+1,
            pairs_obj(Bs, BObj),
            ev(answer, [comp-main, stage-J, index-I1, text-Text, bindings-BObj, steps-Steps1,
                        det-Det1, cps-NCP1]),
            session_more(I1, Cap, Det1, Steps1, Obs1, Extra1, J, E)
        ;   session_end(Reply, J, E, Steps, Extra)
        )
    ).

session_end(Reply, J, E, _LastSteps, _Extra) :-
    engine_steps(E, Steps, Extra),
    session_out(OB, EB),
    (   Reply == '$h_failed'
    ->  ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-exhausted, steps-Steps, det-false,
                      observe-obj([where-'after-failure']), out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra])
    ;   Reply = '$h_exception'(Ex)
    ->  (   Ex == inference_limit_exceeded
        ->  End = budget, Text = null
        ;   End = error, message_text(Ex, Text)
        ),
        format(string(Term), "~q", [Ex]),
        ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-End, steps-Steps, error_text-Text, error_term-Term,
                      out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra])
    ;   format(string(T), "~q", [Reply]),
        ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-error, steps-Steps,
                      error_text-"the session engine ended without a harness reply",
                      error_term-T, out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra])
    ).

%   The engine's own counts, read from the main thread after it stopped:
%   the program's steps are kept by the engine (statistics inside it);
%   after an exception the engine reports them in its at_exception event.
engine_steps(_E, null, [counts-null, held-null, samples-null]).

session_out(OB, EB) :-
    flush_output(user_output), flush_output(user_error),
    out_positions(OB, EB).

                 /*******************************
                 *            SESSION           *
                 *******************************/

%   The main computation is an engine, created once; each stage is posted
%   into it with engine_post/3. Inside, the posted stages form one growing
%   conjunction: stage(1, Vars), ..., stage(L, Vars), L the latest stage
%   posted. When the computation reaches the end of stage L it yields to
%   the harness (a point) and waits for the next message. If it
%   backtracks into an earlier stage and comes forward again, the stages
%   after it that were already posted are called again from the record,
%   without a new message, as in any conjunction. Each message is
%   stage(J, Collect), where Collect says what to do at the end of J:
%     replay  a stage replayed in a reposed or separate run: yield at once
%     point   yield the state held (print, observe), without consuming it
%     here    call query(J, Vars) and collect answers by backtracking inside
%             the engine; used only where nothing extends the computation
%             afterwards (the instance's last stage, or a separate run)
%   h_wait/0, called by a program's supporting code, is the same advance
%   from inside a stage: it yields (the computation waits) only when no
%   posted stage is left to call.

session_main(Posts) :-
    unknown_vars(main, VB, Vars),
    nb_setval(h_comp, main),
    nb_getval(h_events, EvS),
    nb_getval(h_spool, SpS),
    ctl(cap_main, Cap),
    engine_create(R, engine_main(VB, Vars, EvS, SpS, R), E, []),
    session_posts(Posts, E, Cap).

engine_main(VB, Vars, EvS, SpS, R) :-
    nb_setval(h_events, EvS),
    nb_setval(h_spool, SpS),
    nb_setval(h_engine, true),
    nb_setval(h_comp, main),
    nb_setval(h_k, 0),
    nb_setval(h_latest, 0),
    nb_setval(h_collect, point),
    nb_setval(h_render, none),
    comp_flag(main, h_excl, XF), flag(XF, _, 0),
    comp_flag(main, h_entered, EF), flag(EF, _, 0),
    retractall(cnt(main, _)), retractall(held(main, _, _)),
    reset_samples(main),
    b_setval(h_vars, VB),
    b_setval(h_vars_list, Vars),
    b_setval(h_part, 0),
    b_setval(h_done, 0),
    nb_setval(h_exc_seen, false),
    nb_setval(h_base, 0),
    nb_setval(h_armed, true),
    (   ctl(mode, storage) -> ctl(heartbeat, HB), set_prolog_flag(heartbeat, HB) ; true ),
    prolog_current_frame(F),
    nb_setval(h_catch_frame, F),
    catch(( engine_body(VB, Vars, R) ; engine_exhausted(R) ), Ex, R = '$h_exception'(Ex)).

engine_exhausted('$h_exhausted'(S, Extra)) :-
    steps_now(2, S),
    point_extra(Extra).

engine_body(VB, Vars, R) :-
    prolog_current_choice(M),
    nb_setval(h_mark, M),
    engine_fetch(Msg),
    statistics(inferences, I0),
    B is I0 + 2,                % nb_setval/2 and the call of engine_first/4
    nb_setval(h_base, B),
    engine_first(Msg, VB, Vars, R).

engine_first(Msg, VB, Vars, R) :-
    h_receive(4, Msg, J),
    engine_step(J, VB, Vars, R).

%   engine_step(+J, ...): call stage J, then advance.
engine_step(J, VB, Vars, R) :-
    h_mark_stage(J),
    user:stage(J, Vars),
    h_after(VB, Next),
    (   Next == here
    ->  nb_getval(h_latest, K),
        user:query(K, Vars),
        h_eanswer(VB, Stop),
        Stop == true,
        R = '$h_stopped'
    ;   engine_step(Next, VB, Vars, R)
    ).

%   Paused: record a stage message as posted (latest, collect mode).
h_receive(Pre, Msg, J) :-
    h_paused(Pre, receive_(Msg, J0), receive),
    J = J0.
receive_(stage(J, Collect), J, _, L, L) :-
    nb_setval(h_latest, J),
    nb_setval(h_collect, Collect).

%   The mark, in an engine: as h_m/1, and the stage is now done up to J
%   (backtrackable).
h_mark_stage(J) :-
    h_paused(3, mstage_(J), mark).        % engine_step's call port is counted here
mstage_(J, Steps, L0, L) :-
    b_setval(h_done, J),
    m_(J, Steps, L0, L).

%   At the end of a stage's goal: the next stage to call, or here.
h_after(VB, Next) :-
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    h_paused(3, after_(VB, Ch, Next0), point),
    Next = Next0.
after_(VB, Ch, Next, Steps, L, L) :-
    b_getval(h_done, D),
    nb_getval(h_latest, Lt),
    (   D < Lt
    ->  Next is D+1
    ;   nb_getval(h_collect, Collect),
        (   Collect == here
        ->  Next = here
        ;   point_yield(VB, Ch, Steps, '$h_point', Msg),
            receive_(Msg, Next, Steps, L, _)
        )
    ).

point_yield(VB, Ch, Steps, Kind, Msg) :-
    nb_getval(h_latest, K),
    nb_getval(h_collect, Collect),
    nb_getval(h_mark, M),
    (   Collect == replay
    ->  Obs = [], Extra = []
    ;   state_pairs(VB, M, Ch, Kind, Obs),
        point_extra(Extra)
    ),
    (   Ch =< M -> Det = true ; Det = false ),
    Reply =.. [Kind, K, Steps, Det, Obs, Extra],
    engine_yield(Reply),
    engine_fetch(Msg).

%   h_wait/0, inside an engine.
wait_advance(J) :-
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    h_paused(4, wait_(Ch, J0), wait),        % h_wait/0's call port is counted here
    J = J0.
wait_(Ch, J, Steps, L, L) :-
    b_getval(h_done, D),
    nb_getval(h_latest, Lt),
    (   D < Lt
    ->  J is D+1
    ;   b_getval(h_vars, VB),
        point_yield(VB, Ch, Steps, '$h_waiting', Msg),
        receive_(Msg, J, Steps, L, _)
    ).

h_eanswer(VB, Stop) :-
    prolog_current_choice(Ch),
    h_paused(3, eanswer_(VB, Ch, Stop0), answer),
    Stop = Stop0.
eanswer_(VB, Ch, Stop, Steps, L, L) :-
    nb_getval(h_mark, M),
    (   Ch =< M -> Det = true ; Det = false ),
    render_answer(VB, Det, Text, Bs),
    (   ctl(mode, storage) -> cp_count(Ch, M, NCP, _) ; NCP = null ),
    state_pairs(VB, M, Ch, boundary, Obs),
    point_extra(Extra),
    engine_yield('$h_answer'(Text, Bs, Steps, Det, NCP, Obs, Extra)),
    engine_fetch(Msg),
    (   Msg == '$h_more' -> Stop = false ; Stop = true ).

%   The main thread's side: post each stage and report what comes back.
session_posts([], _, _).
session_posts([post(J, Collect)|Ps], E, Cap) :-
    session_out(OB, EB),
    ev(post, [stage-J, collect-Collect, out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB]),
    engine_reply(E, stage(J, Collect), Reply),
    session_reply(Reply, J, Collect, E, Cap, Cont),
    (   Cont == true -> session_posts(Ps, E, Cap) ; true ).

engine_reply(E, Msg, Reply) :-
    (   catch(engine_post(E, Msg, Reply0), Ex, Reply0 = '$h_exception'(Ex))
    ->  Reply = Reply0
    ;   Reply = '$h_failed'
    ).

session_reply('$h_point'(K, Steps, Det, Obs, Extra), J, Collect, _, _, true) :- !,
    session_out(OB, EB),
    ev(point, [stage-J, k-K, collect-Collect, steps-Steps, det-Det, observe-obj(Obs),
               out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra]).
session_reply('$h_waiting'(K, Steps, Det, Obs, Extra), J, Collect, _, _, true) :- !,
    session_out(OB, EB),
    ev(waiting, [stage-J, k-K, collect-Collect, steps-Steps, det-Det, observe-obj(Obs),
                 out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra]).
session_reply('$h_answer'(Text, Bs, Steps, Det, NCP, Obs, Extra), J, _, E, Cap, false) :- !,
    pairs_obj(Bs, BObj),
    ev(answer, [comp-main, stage-J, index-1, text-Text, bindings-BObj, steps-Steps, det-Det, cps-NCP]),
    session_more(1, Cap, Det, Steps, Obs, Extra, J, E).
session_reply(Other, J, _, _, _, false) :-
    session_end(Other, J).

session_more(I, Cap, Det, Steps, Obs, Extra, J, E) :-
    (   Det == true
    ->  session_out(OB, EB),
        ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-det, steps-Steps, det-true, observe-obj(Obs),
                      out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra])
    ;   I >= Cap
    ->  session_out(OB, EB),
        ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-cap, steps-Steps, det-false, observe-obj(Obs),
                      out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra])
    ;   engine_reply(E, '$h_more', Reply),
        (   Reply = '$h_answer'(Text, Bs, Steps1, Det1, NCP1, Obs1, Extra1)
        ->  I1 is I+1,
            pairs_obj(Bs, BObj),
            ev(answer, [comp-main, stage-J, index-I1, text-Text, bindings-BObj, steps-Steps1,
                        det-Det1, cps-NCP1]),
            session_more(I1, Cap, Det1, Steps1, Obs1, Extra1, J, E)
        ;   session_end(Reply, J)
        )
    ).

session_end(Reply, J) :-
    session_out(OB, EB),
    (   Reply = '$h_exhausted'(Steps, Extra)
    ->  ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-exhausted, steps-Steps, det-false,
                      observe-obj([where-'after-failure']), out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB|Extra])
    ;   Reply = '$h_exception'(Ex)
    ->  (   Ex == inference_limit_exceeded
        ->  End = budget, Text = null
        ;   End = error, message_text(Ex, Text)
        ),
        format(string(Term), "~q", [Ex]),
        ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-End, steps-null, error_text-Text, error_term-Term,
                      out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB])
    ;   format(string(T), "~q", [Reply]),
        ev(comp_end, [comp-main, stage-J, ended_by-error, steps-null,
                      error_text-"the session engine ended without a harness reply",
                      error_term-T, out_bytes-OB, err_bytes-EB])
    ).

session_out(OB, EB) :-
    flush_output(user_output), flush_output(user_error),
    out_positions(OB, EB).

# Pins

*Candidate for `spec-1.0`.* The version or commit of every system in the
first comparison, fixed at the freeze (`PROTOCOL.md`, phase 3). A change
to any of them after the freeze makes a new configuration, reported
separately.

| system | what is pinned | pin | used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Absys | the reconstruction, https://github.com/chrishayuk/absys, `main` | `efd5203` | behaviour |
| | the same, branch `measure` (`--measure`, `--full`) | `5450449` | cost and storage; `--full` output |
| | the behavioural reference, before the printer fix | `7bb61e6` | kept, not run |
| SWI-Prolog | the `swipl:11.0.1` image | `sha256:b51af487f3306fe240eae8c13159c85b5526509952e1b949cc22f48a1f82a742` | every mode |
| Python | the `python:3.13.7` image (CPython 3.13.7) | `sha256:fe841081ec55481496a4ab25e538833741295d57d2abdec8d38d74d65fb4715b` | every mode |
| ALGOL 60 | the interpreter, https://github.com/chrishayuk/algol-60, `main` | `6e8740c` | *report* and *x1*: behaviour and cost |
| | the same, branch `measure` (`--measure`) | `151cdff` | storage |
| | x1sim: Vakulenko's X1 compiler and simulator, https://github.com/sergev/x1-algol-compiler | `938fa03` | *x1sim*: behaviour only |

Results are taken on Linux x86_64 in the pinned images, or from the pinned
commits built there with the toolchain the repository's CI uses. The
measurements were also qualified on macOS arm64 (SWI-Prolog 11.0.1 from
Homebrew; CPython 3.13.7 from python-build-standalone), where every count
compared was the same; a figure from macOS is marked as such.

## Why each commit

- **Absys `efd5203`** is `7bb61e6` with one defect fixed: printing a list
  that contains itself (`x = [x]`, problem P01c) overflowed the stack, after
  the computation had finished. Only the printer changed. Against
  `7bb61e6`, every example and research text prints byte for byte the same
  in eight output modes and as JSON (160 runs); only runs that crashed print
  differently. The defect is recorded in the reconstruction's
  `docs/decisions.md`, "Defects found in the reconstruction".
- **Absys `5450449`** is the measurement branch rebased onto `efd5203`.
  Against `efd5203`, with measurement on and off, its output is the same
  byte for byte (`systems/absys/README.md`).
- **ALGOL 60 `151cdff`** was checked against `6e8740c` on all 100 programs
  of that repository, in both dialects, with measurement on and off (200
  runs).
briefs
Containerfile.agent
Containerfile.systems
README.md
# Sandbox

How roles after the freeze are run (`PROTOCOL.md`, "Roles").

**Agents.** Each harness author, implementation author and classifier is a
separate agent with its own context, given only its brief (`briefs/`,
verbatim) and its own fresh clone of this public repository, at the
commit it works on, in which it writes. It enters the repository only
through a commit on its own branch, merged after it ends. Agents run on
the owner's machine, under the owner's account. They are told to read
nothing outside their clone and the pinned system sources, but this is
not enforced: other agent sessions on the machine were readable. None of
those sessions contains the hidden variants' plaintext. The variants are
age ciphertext and the custodian's transcript is encrypted to the
owner's key. The harness authors, who write no program and use no
constants, ran while that key was an unprotected file in the owner's home
directory; implementation authors start only after it is
passphrase-protected, so that no agent can decrypt either.

**Systems.** Programs are run in the pinned images, on Linux x86_64 under
Apple's `container` (Rosetta on an arm64 Mac).

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| `Containerfile.systems` | the pinned Absys and ALGOL 60 builds and x1sim (`PINS.md`), cloned from GitHub at their commits and built with Rust 1.98.0 |
| `Containerfile.agent` | adds an unprivileged user (and agent CLIs, unused) to a pinned image |
| `briefs/` | the brief each role was given, verbatim |

## Images

| image | base | id |
|---|---|---|
| `cp-systems:spec-1.0` | `rust:1.98.0-bookworm` `sha256:82150a52ec202c1b14d7817e14516c392bb7f5cfebd88f1ed531cb37ebd39922` | `08ccf0f27d55…` |
| `cp-agent-systems:spec-1.0` | `cp-systems:spec-1.0` | `23fefb8016c5…` |
| `cp-agent-swi-prolog:spec-1.0` | `swipl:11.0.1` (pinned digest) | `bbe4166e4219…` |
| `cp-agent-python:spec-1.0` | `python:3.13.7` (pinned digest) | `65d15cef3fa5…` |

The pinned CI images fix SWI-Prolog and CPython. The Absys and ALGOL 60 repositories' CI uses
"stable" Rust; the sandbox fixes 1.98.0, the release current at the
freeze.

## Syntax checking before a program is fixed

`PROTOCOL.md`, phase 5: programs are "fixed before any of them is run".
Checking a program's syntax, without executing any of it, is not running
it. So:

| | |
|---|---|
| **syntax check** | permitted before a program is fixed, with the harness's `check`, which parses or compiles and executes nothing |
| **execution** | none, of any kind, before the primary program is committed |
| **tuning on results** | never (`PROTOCOL.md`, "Writing a program", rule 7) |
| **transcription fixes** | after results, as rule 7 says, each recorded as a diff with its reason |

The restriction on executing is enforced by audit: every command an
implementation author ran is in its transcript, and any execution other
than `check` is reported as a breach of protocol with the program it
touched. A program that fails to run in its primary run keeps that result; a corrected
transcription is reported beside it, never in its place.

%   ('$inference_limit_false'/1 sets it, absolutely) stands at the raw
%   count where program step End + slack + 1 falls, slack being the most
%   inferences any harness entry spends before it lifts the limit (so that
%   entering harness code never trips it). Every harness entry then
%   checks the budget exactly: if Steps > End it raises
%   inference_limit_exceeded itself, as the system's limit would have.
%   So a stage is budget exactly when its program steps exceed its budget
%   at some point; between harness entries the system's limit stops it at
%   most slack inferences late.

    statistics(inferences, A),

/*  harnesses/swi-prolog/check CONFIGURATION PROGRAM  (cp-roles, spec-1.0)

    A syntax and static check that executes nothing of the program. It
    reads the program's terms with read_term/3 (the reader SWI-Prolog's
    compiler uses), reports syntax errors verbatim as SWI-Prolog's message
    system words them, and then checks the terms it read without calling
    any of them:

      - no clause is compiled or asserted, no directive is executed, no
        goal of the program is called, nothing is posed;
      - three kinds of directive are interpreted for their effect on
        reading only: op/3 (applied to a scratch module), and
        use_module/1,2 and ensure_loaded/1 of library(...) files (the
        library is loaded into the scratch module, so that its operators,
        such as clpfd's #=, are known and its exports count as defined).
        Loading a library runs the library's own code, never the
        program's;
      - every other directive is listed as not executed.

    Then, statically: singleton variables (as the compiler would warn),
    calls to procedures that nothing defines (the program's clauses and
    dynamic declarations, built-ins, the libraries it loads, the
    autoload index, the harness's H predicates), the harness contract
    (unknowns/2, stage/2, query/2, spawned/3), the CONSTANTS block, the
    PROVENANCE comment, and mechanisms that the configuration does not
    have (systems/swi-prolog/README.md).

    Exit status: 0 no error; 1 errors (syntax errors, or no stage/2 and no
    spawned/3); 2 usage.
*/

:- module(cp_check, [main/0]).

:- use_module(library(lists)).
:- use_module(library(apply)).
:- use_module(library(readutil)).

:- dynamic defined/2, called/4, directive_seen/3, error_count/1, used_mech/3, clause_count/1.

configs([plain, tabling, coroutines, constraints, session]).

main :-
    current_prolog_flag(argv, Argv),
    (   Argv = [C0, P0|_]
    ->  atom_string(C, C0), atom_string(P, P0)
    ;   format(user_error, "usage: check CONFIGURATION PROGRAM~n", []), halt(2)
    ),
    configs(Cs),
    (   memberchk(C, Cs) -> true
    ;   format(user_error, "check: unknown configuration ~w (one of ~w)~n", [C, Cs]), halt(2)
    ),
    (   exists_file(P) -> true
    ;   format(user_error, "check: no file ~w~n", [P]), halt(2)
    ),
    assertz(error_count(0)), assertz(clause_count(0)),
    format("check: ~w, configuration ~w (SWI-Prolog ~w). Nothing of the program is executed.~n",
           [P, C, '11.0.1']),
    absolute_file_name(P, Abs),
    read_program(Abs),
    static_checks(C, Abs),
    error_count(N),
    (   N =:= 0
    ->  format("check: no errors~n", []), halt(0)
    ;   format("check: ~d error(s)~n", [N]), halt(1)
    ).

bump :- retract(error_count(N)), N1 is N+1, assertz(error_count(N1)).

%   A scratch module for reading: operators declared by op/3 and by loaded
%   libraries live here, never in user.
scratch(cp_check_program).

read_program(File) :-
    scratch(M),
    (   current_module(M) -> true ; set_module(M:class(temporary)) ),
    setup_call_cleanup(open(File, read, S, [encoding(utf8)]),
                       read_terms(S, File, M),
                       close(S)).

read_terms(S, File, M) :-
    catch(read_term(S, T, [module(M), variable_names(Vs), singletons(Ss),
                           term_position(Pos), syntax_errors(error)]),
          E, true),
    (   nonvar(E)
    ->  print_message(error, E),       % SWI-Prolog's own wording, verbatim
        bump,
        (   E = error(syntax_error(_), _) -> read_terms(S, File, M)
        ;   true
        )
    ;   T == end_of_file
    ->  true
    ;   stream_position_data(line_count, Pos, Line),
        term(T, Vs, Ss, File, Line, M),
        read_terms(S, File, M)
    ).

term((:- D), _, _, File, Line, M) :- !,
    directive(D, File, Line, M).
term((?- D), _, _, File, Line, M) :- !,
    directive(D, File, Line, M).
term(T, Vs, Ss, File, Line, _M) :-
    retract(clause_count(C0)), C1 is C0+1, assertz(clause_count(C1)),
    singletons(Ss, Vs, File, Line),
    (   T = (H :- B) -> true ; T = (H --> B0) -> B = dcg(B0) ; H = T, B = true ),
    (   callable(H)
    ->  functor(H, N, A0),
        (   T = (_ --> _) -> A is A0+2 ; A = A0 ),
        assertz(defined(N/A, Line)),
        (   B = dcg(_) -> true ; body_calls(B, N/A, File, Line) ),
        mechanisms_in(B, Line)
    ;   format(user_error, "ERROR: ~w:~d: a clause whose head is not callable: ~q~n", [File, Line, T]),
        bump
    ).

singletons([], _, _, _) :- !.
singletons(Ss, _, File, Line) :-
    findall(N, ( member(N=_, Ss), \+ sub_atom(N, 0, _, _, '_') ), Ns),
    (   Ns == [] -> true
    ;   format(user_error, "Warning: ~w:~d:~nWarning:    Singleton variables: ~w~n", [File, Line, Ns])
    ).

%   Directives: op/3 and library loading are interpreted for reading;
%   everything else is listed and not executed.
directive(D, File, Line, M) :-
    assertz(directive_seen(D, File, Line)),
    (   D = op(P, T, Ns)
    ->  catch(op(P, T, M:Ns), E, (print_message(error, E), bump)),
        format("  ~w:~d: op/3 applied for reading only~n", [File, Line])
    ;   library_directive(D, Lib)
    ->  catch(( use_module(M:library(Lib)) ), E,
              (print_message(error, E), bump)),
        format("  ~w:~d: library(~w) loaded for its operators and exports (the library's code, not the program's)~n",
               [File, Line, Lib]),
        assertz(used_mech(library(Lib), Line, directive))
    ;   D = dynamic(Spec)
    ->  forall(pi_member(Spec, PI), assertz(defined(PI, Line))),
        format("  ~w:~d: :- dynamic ~q (declaration noted, not executed)~n", [File, Line, Spec])
    ;   D = discontiguous(_)
    ->  true
    ;   D = table(Spec)
    ->  assertz(used_mech(table, Line, directive)),
        forall(pi_member(Spec, PI), assertz(used_mech(tabled(PI), Line, directive))),
        format("  ~w:~d: :- table ~q (noted, not executed)~n", [File, Line, Spec])
    ;   format("  ~w:~d: directive NOT executed by check: ~q~n", [File, Line, D])
    ).

library_directive(use_module(library(L)), L).
library_directive(use_module(library(L), _), L).
library_directive(ensure_loaded(library(L)), L).
library_directive(autoload(library(L)), L).
library_directive(autoload(library(L), _), L).

pi_member(Spec, _) :- var(Spec), !, fail.
pi_member((A, B), PI) :- !, ( pi_member(A, PI) ; pi_member(B, PI) ).
pi_member([H|T], PI) :- !, ( pi_member(H, PI) ; pi_member(T, PI) ).
pi_member(_:S, PI) :- !, pi_member(S, PI).
pi_member(S as _, PI) :- !, pi_member(S, PI).
pi_member(N/A, N/A) :- atom(N), integer(A).
pi_member(N//A, N/A2) :- atom(N), integer(A), A2 is A+2.

%   Calls in a body, through the control constructs and the meta-calls
%   whose argument is a goal.
body_calls(V, _, _, _) :- var(V), !.
body_calls(_:G, C, F, L) :- !, body_calls(G, C, F, L).
body_calls((A, B), C, F, L) :- !, body_calls(A, C, F, L), body_calls(B, C, F, L).
body_calls((A ; B), C, F, L) :- !, body_calls(A, C, F, L), body_calls(B, C, F, L).
body_calls((A -> B), C, F, L) :- !, body_calls(A, C, F, L), body_calls(B, C, F, L).
body_calls((A *-> B), C, F, L) :- !, body_calls(A, C, F, L), body_calls(B, C, F, L).
body_calls(\+ A, C, F, L) :- !, body_calls(A, C, F, L).
body_calls(G, C, F, L) :-
    callable(G),
    functor(G, N, A),
    assertz(called(N/A, C, F, L)),
    forall(meta_arg(G, Sub), body_calls(Sub, C, F, L)).

meta_arg(call(G), G).
meta_arg(once(G), G).
meta_arg(ignore(G), G).
meta_arg(forall(A, B), G) :- ( G = A ; G = B ).
meta_arg(findall(_, G, _), G).
meta_arg(findall(_, G, _, _), G).
meta_arg(bagof(_, G, _), G1) :- strip_carets(G, G1).
meta_arg(setof(_, G, _), G1) :- strip_carets(G, G1).
meta_arg(aggregate_all(_, G, _), G).
meta_arg(catch(G, _, R), X) :- ( X = G ; X = R ).
meta_arg(call_cleanup(G, R), X) :- ( X = G ; X = R ).
meta_arg(setup_call_cleanup(S, G, R), X) :- ( X = S ; X = G ; X = R ).
meta_arg(freeze(_, G), G).
meta_arg(when(_, G), G).
meta_arg(call_with_inference_limit(G, _, _), G).
meta_arg(engine_create(_, G, _), G).
meta_arg(engine_create(_, G, _, _), G).
meta_arg(tnot(G), G).

strip_carets(V, V) :- var(V), !.
strip_carets(_^G, G1) :- !, strip_carets(G, G1).
strip_carets(G, G).

%   Mechanisms by configuration (systems/swi-prolog/README.md).
mechanism(freeze/2, coroutining).
mechanism(when/2, coroutining).
mechanism(dif/2, coroutining).
mechanism(frozen/2, coroutining).
mechanism(engine_create/3, engines).
mechanism(engine_create/4, engines).
mechanism(engine_post/2, engines).
mechanism(engine_post/3, engines).
mechanism(engine_fetch/1, engines).
mechanism(engine_yield/1, engines).
mechanism(engine_next/2, engines).
mechanism(engine_destroy/1, engines).
mechanism(h_wait/0, engines).
mechanism(tnot/1, tabling).

mechanisms_in(_, _).

has(plain, []).
has(tabling, [tabling]).
has(coroutines, [coroutining]).
has(constraints, [coroutining, constraints]).
has(session, [coroutining, constraints, engines]).

static_checks(Config, File) :-
    contract(File),
    undefined_calls(File),
    configuration_mechanisms(Config, File),
    constants_block(File),
    provenance(File).

contract(File) :-
    forall(member(PI-What, [unknowns/2-"the computations' unknowns",
                            stage/2-"each stage's information",
                            query/2-"the query after each stage",
                            spawned/3-"the goal of a spawned computation (P09 only)"]),
           (   defined(PI, _) -> format("  contract: ~w defined (~s)~n", [PI, What])
           ;   format("  contract: ~w not defined (~s)~n", [PI, What])
           )),
    (   ( defined(stage/2, _) ; defined(spawned/3, _) ) -> true
    ;   format(user_error, "ERROR: ~w: neither stage/2 nor spawned/3 is defined: nothing can be posed~n", [File]),
        bump
    ),
    (   defined(stage/2, _), \+ defined(query/2, _)
    ->  format(user_error, "ERROR: ~w: stage/2 is defined but query/2 is not; the harness calls query(K, Vars) after stage K~n", [File]),
        bump
    ;   true
    ),
    (   ( defined(stage/2, _) ; defined(spawned/3, _) ), \+ defined(unknowns/2, _)
    ->  format(user_error, "Warning: ~w: unknowns/2 is not defined: every computation has no unknowns, and answers show only residual goals~n", [File])
    ;   true
    ).

h_pred(h_param/2). h_pred(h_commitment/1). h_pred(emit/1). h_pred(h_count/1).
h_pred(h_candidate/0). h_pred(h_held/2). h_pred(h_wait/0).

undefined_calls(_File) :-
    scratch(M),
    forall(( called(PI, In, F, L), \+ known(PI, M) ),
           format(user_error, "Warning: ~w:~d: ~q calls ~q, which nothing defines (not executed; it would raise an existence error, as the unknown flag is error)~n", [F, L, In, PI])).

known(PI, _) :- defined(PI, _), !.
known(PI, _) :- h_pred(PI), !.
known(N/A, M) :-
    functor(G, N, A),
    (   predicate_property(system:G, defined)
    ;   predicate_property(M:G, imported_from(_))
    ;   predicate_property(M:G, defined)
    ;   '$find_library'(user, N, A, _, _)
    ;   control(N/A)
    ), !.

control((',')/2). control((;)/2). control((->)/2). control((*->)/2). control((\+)/1).
control(!/0). control(true/0). control(fail/0). control(false/0). control((=)/2).
control((:)/2). control(call/_).

configuration_mechanisms(Config, File) :-
    has(Config, Has),
    forall(( called(PI, In, F, L), mechanism(PI, Mech), \+ memberchk(Mech, Has) ),
           format(user_error, "Warning: ~w:~d: ~q calls ~q (~w), which configuration ~w does not have~n",
                  [F, L, In, PI, Mech, Config])),
    forall(( used_mech(table, L, _), \+ memberchk(tabling, Has) ),
           format(user_error, "Warning: ~w:~d: a table directive, which configuration ~w does not have~n", [File, L, Config])),
    forall(( used_mech(library(Lib), L, _), lib_mech(Lib, Mech), \+ memberchk(Mech, Has) ),
           format(user_error, "Warning: ~w:~d: library(~w) (~w), which configuration ~w does not have~n",
                  [File, L, Lib, Mech, Config])).

lib_mech(clpfd, constraints).
lib_mech(clpq, constraints).
lib_mech(clpr, constraints).
lib_mech(clpb, constraints).
lib_mech(chr, constraints).
lib_mech(when, coroutining).
lib_mech(dif, coroutining).
lib_mech(tabling, tabling).

%   The marked constants block (README, "Constants").
constants_block(File) :-
    read_file_to_string(File, Text, [encoding(utf8)]),
    split_string(Text, "\n", "", Lines),
    findall(I, ( nth1(I, Lines, L), sub_string(L, _, _, _, "CONSTANTS BEGIN"), comment_line(L) ), Bs),
    findall(I, ( nth1(I, Lines, L), sub_string(L, _, _, _, "CONSTANTS END"), comment_line(L) ), Es),
    (   Bs == [], Es == []
    ->  format("  constants: no CONSTANTS block (recorded as constants: none)~n", [])
    ;   Bs = [B], Es = [E], B < E
    ->  format("  constants: one block, lines ~d-~d (recorded as constants: block)~n", [B, E]),
        block_terms(File, B, E)
    ;   format(user_error, "ERROR: ~w: the CONSTANTS BEGIN / CONSTANTS END comment lines must be one pair, in that order (found BEGIN at ~w, END at ~w)~n", [File, Bs, Es]),
        bump
    ).

comment_line(L) :- split_string(L, "", " \t", [S]), sub_string(S, 0, 1, _, "%").

block_terms(_File, B, E) :-
    findall(L-T, ( directive_seen(T, _, L) ), Ds),
    forall(( member(L-T, Ds), L > B, L < E ),
           format(user_error, "Warning: line ~d: a directive inside the CONSTANTS block: ~q (the block should hold only constants)~n", [L, T])).

provenance(File) :-
    read_file_to_string(File, Text, [encoding(utf8)]),
    (   sub_string(Text, _, _, _, "PROVENANCE")
    ->  format("  provenance: a PROVENANCE comment is present~n", [])
    ;   format(user_error, "Warning: ~w: no PROVENANCE comment (README, \"Provenance\")~n", [File])
    ).

/*  Direct measurement for the qualification: the made-up program run in
    SWI-Prolog without the harness, measured as the systems file qualifies
    it (systems/swi-prolog/README.md, "Units"; measurement.md).

        swipl -f none -q direct.pl PROGRAM K CAP

    Loads PROGRAM (which must not call H predicates other than none), and
    poses stages 1..K and query(K) as one conjunction written into one
    clause, so that nothing but the program's goals lies between the two
    statistics/2 calls. Prints one line per figure, key=value:

      first     steps to the first answer: statistics(inferences)
                difference minus one, around the conjunction
      minlimit  the smallest limit under which call_with_inference_limit/3
                lets '$q'(Vars) reach its first answer, found by bisection
                (expected: first + 1, the call port of '$q'/1)
      at        steps at each answer (up to CAP), from a failure-driven
                loop whose recorder costs R inferences per answer, R
                measured here and subtracted
      end       steps when the enumeration is exhausted (or at CAP)
      cps       retained choicepoints at each answer: the probe's own
                counter (systems/swi-prolog/probes/cpcount.pl), from a mark
                taken where the query starts
      attvars, residual_goals  at the first answer (term_attvars/2,
                copy_term/3), as the harness's observe() reads them
      global_live_delta  bytes of live global data (garbage_collect/0,
                statistics(globalused)) at the first answer, minus before
      tables, table_answers  (when the program tables) after exhaustion
*/

:- initialization(main, main).
:- use_module('../../../systems/swi-prolog/probes/cpcount').
:- use_module(library(prolog_autoload)).

main :-
    current_prolog_flag(argv, [Prog, KA, CapA|_]),
    atom_number(KA, K), atom_number(CapA, Cap),
    load_files(user:Prog, []),
    autoload_all,
    ( catch(user:unknowns(main, Names), _, fail) -> true ; Names = [] ),
    length(Names, N), length(Vars, N),
    conjunction(K, Vars, Conj),
    % steps to the first answer, inline
    assertz((m1(V, D) :- statistics(inferences, A), V = Vars, Conj, statistics(inferences, B), D is B-A-1)),
    copy_term(m1(_, _), M1), ( call(M1) -> arg(2, M1, First) ; First = none ),
    out(first, First),
    % the call_with_inference_limit/3 agreement
    assertz(('$q'(Vars) :- Conj)),
    copy_term(Vars, Vq),
    minlimit(user:'$q'(Vq), 1, 100000000, ML), out(minlimit, ML),
    % every answer, with a recorder
    assertz((rec_cost(R) :- statistics(inferences, A), nb_setval(r, []), statistics(inferences, B0), nb_getval(r, L0), nb_setval(r, [B0|L0]), statistics(inferences, B), R is B-B0)),
    rec_cost(R), out(recorder, R),
    assertz((mall(Cap, Ds, End) :-
                nb_setval(r, []), nb_setval(c, 0),
                statistics(inferences, A),
                (   Conj,
                    statistics(inferences, B), nb_getval(r, L0), nb_setval(r, [B|L0]),
                    nb_getval(c, C0), C is C0+1, nb_setval(c, C), C >= Cap
                ->  statistics(inferences, E0)
                ;   statistics(inferences, E0)
                ),
                nb_getval(r, Bs0), reverse(Bs0, Bs),
                findall(D, ( nth1(I, Bs, Bi), D is Bi - A - 1 - (I-1)*(R+4) ), Ds),
                length(Bs, NA),
                End is E0 - A - 1 - NA*(R+4))),
    mall(Cap, Ds, End),
    out(at, Ds), out(end, End),
    % choicepoints at each answer, the probe's counter
    assertz((mcp(Cap, Ns) :- nb_setval(r, []), nb_setval(c, 0),
                ( cpq(Vars, Cap) -> true ; true ),
                nb_getval(r, Ns0), reverse(Ns0, Ns))),
    assertz((cpq(Vars, Cap) :- prolog_current_choice(Mk), Conj, cp_since(Mk, NC),
                nb_getval(r, L0), nb_setval(r, [NC|L0]),
                nb_getval(c, C0), C is C0+1, nb_setval(c, C), C >= Cap)),
    mcp(Cap, Ns), out(cps, Ns),
    % attributed variables, residual goals and live global data at the first answer
    garbage_collect, statistics(globalused, G0),
    (   copy_term(Vars-Conj, V2-C2), call(C2)
    ->  term_attvars(V2, AVs), length(AVs, NAV),
        copy_term(V2, _, Gs), length(Gs, NG),
        garbage_collect, statistics(globalused, G1), GD is G1 - G0,
        out(attvars, NAV), out(residual_goals, NG), out(global_live_delta, GD),
        ignore(V2 = V2)
    ;   out(attvars, none)
    ),
    (   current_table(_:_, _)
    ->  copy_term(Vars-Conj, _-C3), forall(call(C3), true),
        findall(Cn, ( current_table(_:_, Tr), trie_property(Tr, value_count(Cn)) ), Cs),
        length(Cs, NT), sum_list(Cs, NTA),
        statistics(table_space_used, TSU),
        out(tables, NT), out(table_answers, NTA), out(table_space_used_bytes, TSU)
    ;   true
    ).

conjunction(K, Vars, Conj) :-
    numlist(1, K, Js),
    foldl([J, G0, G]>>( G0 == true -> G = user:stage(J, Vars) ; G = (G0, user:stage(J, Vars)) ), Js, true, G1),
    Conj = (G1, user:query(K, Vars)).

minlimit(_, Lo, Hi, L) :- Lo >= Hi, !, L = Hi.
minlimit(G, Lo, Hi, L) :-
    Mid is (Lo+Hi)//2,
    (   catch(call_with_inference_limit(G, Mid, R), _, R = inference_limit_exceeded),
        R \== inference_limit_exceeded
    ->  minlimit(G, Lo, Mid, L)
    ;   Lo1 is Mid+1, minlimit(G, Lo1, Hi, L)
    ).

out(K, V) :- format("~w=~q~n", [K, V]).

%       * undefined(+Action)
%       Action defines what happens if the analysis finds a
%       definitely undefined predicate.  One of `ignore` or
%       `error`.  Default is `ignore`.

autoload_all :-
    autoload_all([]).

autoload_all(Options) :-
    set_prolog_flag(autoload, false),
    must_be(list, Options),
    statistics(cputime, T0),
    aggregate_all(count, source_file(_), OldFileCount),
    call_cleanup(
        autoload(0, Iterations, Options),
        check:collect_undef(Undef)),
    aggregate_all(count, source_file(_), NewFileCount),
    statistics(cputime, T1),
    Time is T1-T0,
    information_level(Level, Options),
    NewFiles is NewFileCount - OldFileCount,
    print_message(Level, autoload(completed(Iterations, Time, NewFiles))),
    report_undefined(Undef).

autoload(Iteration0, Iterations, Options) :-
    statistics(cputime, T0),
    autoload_step(NewFiles, NewPreds, Options),
    statistics(cputime, T1),
    Time is T1-T0,
    succ(Iteration0, Iteration),
    (   NewFiles > 0
    ->  information_level(Level, Options),
        print_message(Level, autoload(reiterate(Iteration,
                                                NewFiles, NewPreds, Time))),
        autoload(Iteration, Iterations, Options)
    ;   Iterations = Iteration
    ).

information_level(Level, Options) :-
    (   option(verbose(true), Options)
    ->  Level = informational
    ;   Level = silent
    ).

%!  autoload_step(-NewFiles, -NewPreds, +Options) is det.
%
%   Scan through the program and   autoload all undefined referenced
%   predicates.
%
%   @param NewFiles is unified to the number of files loaded
%   @param NewPreds is unified to the number of predicates imported
%          using the autoloader.

autoload_step(NewFiles, NewPreds, Options) :-
    option(verbose(Verbose), Options, false),
    walk_options(Options, WalkOptions),
    aggregate_all(count, source_file(_), OldFileCount),
    setup_call_cleanup(
        ( current_prolog_flag(autoload, OldAutoLoad),
          current_prolog_flag(verbose_autoload, OldVerbose),
          set_prolog_flag(autoload, true),
          set_prolog_flag(verbose_autoload, Verbose),
          assert_autoload_hook(Ref),
          asserta(autoloaded_count(0))
        ),
        prolog_walk_code(WalkOptions),
        ( retract(autoloaded_count(Count)),
          erase(Ref),
          set_prolog_flag(autoload, OldAutoLoad),
          set_prolog_flag(verbose_autoload, OldVerbose)
        )),
    aggregate_all(count, source_file(_), NewFileCount),
    NewPreds = Count,
    NewFiles is NewFileCount - OldFileCount.

assert_autoload_hook(Ref) :-
    asserta((user:message_hook(autoload(Module:Name/Arity, Library), _, _) :-
                    autoloaded(Module:Name/Arity, Library)), Ref).

:- public
    autoloaded/2.
